dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Inventory refers to the production of 1 kg wool respectively live weight. The multioutput-process 'sheep' delivers the co-products 'wool, at farm' (4.2kg/head and year) and 'sheep live weight, at farm' (62.8 kg/head and year). Economic allocation with allocation factor of 22.8% to wool (exceptions see report).; UUID: 624a141e-d314-300f-a4c8-495e4566a906

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: The yield data have been collected for the years 2001-2006.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Conventional production typical for the country. Water for irrigation is pumped from 48 meter depth by electric pumps.

# Included processes
The inventory includes the processes of sheep husbandry on pasture land. Machine infrastructure and a shed for machine sheltering and shearing is included. Inputs of fertilisers, feedstuffs, pesticides and irrigation as well as transports to the farm are considered. The direct emissions on the field are also included. The system boundary is at the farm gate. The products of sheep husbandry are wool and sheep live weight. All further processes after the farm gate like transport to the slaughterhouse, slaughtering, cooling, etc. are excluded.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data come from the NREL database and from varoius U.S database. Data were compiled from statistics, literature, farm survey reports, documents from extension services, and expert knowledge.
